rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the paper's headline claim that r51 is dominated by soft-mode 1/ω² scaling, with the mode-sum model matching Table IV values to <5% MARE when using the paper's own ω values. The predicted r51≈696 pm/V at 0.45% displacement falls within the experimental 730±150 pm/V range. However, no independent DFT calculations were performed—the replication uses the paper's reported frequencies rather than computing them ab initio. The Landau model for ω(displacement) fails quantitatively (33% MARE), showing the anharmonic physics is only qualitatively captured. Coverage is limited because the core computational workflow (QE + Vibroscopy finite-field derivatives) was not executed.
